findings.evidence: docs/managed-rollout.md new "Release rollout" section: "Rollout is manual on this installation: since 2026-10-28 the variable described below is not `true`...". The same section still documents the automatic dispatch via DEV_PLATFORM_MANAGED_ROLLOUT_ENABLED. Explorer nodes (explorer/nodes/copier-rollout.toml lead, managed-rollout.toml) still describe rollout as opening PRs after each release. These nodes were only re-pointed, not reworded.
findings.summary: The platform doc states an operator-specific, time-bound fact as if it were product behavior. It will go stale when the variable is flipped back.

findings.evidence: In reconcile-stale-rollouts.yml, the `if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'` guard is on a single step. The target-token step with permission-contents/pull-requests/workflows write and the registry checkout still run on schedule. That is needed for the alert recovery step, so it is acceptable, but the workflow is no longer a dedicated stale-rollout workflow in name or structure.
findings.summary: The scheduled run of reconcile-stale-rollouts.yml still runs the whole plan job and mints a write-scoped target token per project. Only the supersession step is skipped.
